events.evidence: The U.S. Department of Commerce announces it will relax the blacklist against Huawei to allow American companies to work with the Chinese telecom on setting 5G network standards
The armed forces say an ambush on a military convoy in central Mali has killed at least 24 troops and left others missing
A court in Russia sentences former U.S. Marine Paul Whelan to 16 years in prison for espionage.

label.note: Huawei easing supportive; Mali and social/legal news mixed.
